info.title: Riverwood Main Questline
info.description: The opening arc. Two quests, deliberately short, teaching group combat and escort pacing before the mill siege.

bandit-camp.title: Clear the Bandit Camp
bandit-camp.description: Soft-gated on purpose. A player who skips this can still reach the mill, but at a level disadvantage we consider fair rather than punishing.

reach-camp.title: Find the bandit camp
reach-camp.description: No map marker on purpose. The smoke plume is the intended wayfinding cue.

recover-ledger.title: Recover the stolen ledger
recover-ledger.description: Optional in practice: nothing requires it, but the mill quest reads better if the player has it.

rewards.description: Tuned against the tier-2 armour price, not against playtime.

escort-merchant.title: See the Merchant Home
escort-merchant.description: Paced to be walkable. Combat here is a failure state for the design, not a goal.

meet-merchant.title: Speak to Hilda at the crossroads

escort-to-gate.title: Escort Hilda to the Riverwood gate

rewards.description: The reputation type is not in any vocabulary yet. It validates because 0.1-draft leaves objective and reward types open.
